notes:
Summary: Bridgewater is an enterprise KM provider for regulated UK/EU customers. Primary initiative: replace slow keyword indexing with embedding-based retrieval + lightweight ANN reranking to cut time-to-answer and surface legal-grade results. Key constraints: all processing and storage must remain in EU or UK datacenters (no US fallback for PII subsets), strong audit/KMS requirements, and a cost per query target aligned to enterprise budgeting.

Customer goals / asks (verbatim + paraphrase):
- 'We need sub-120ms median end-to-end search for support flows; <50ms for cached prefix queries.'
- 'Indexing: 150-250M documents initially, steady-state +10% / month incremental ingestion.'
- 'Want quality lift from ANN->reranker: recall-first ANN (HNSW/IVF) then cross-encoder rerank for top-10.'
- 'Cost target €0.002-€0.01 per query depending on reranker usage — must show unit economics.'

Technical notes / requirements:
- POC acceptance: ingest 200M doc test corpus, run 1000 QPS synthetic at 95th percentile latency <300ms, median <120ms, reranker p95 <200ms when invoked.
- ANN strategy: evaluate HNSW (memory) vs IVF+PQ (disk+quant) tradeoffs; recommend hybrid for EU dedicated clusters.
- Reranker: cross-encoder on small GPU pool with warm KV cache; consider offloading candidate scoring to optimized CPU if cross-encoder cost is too high.
- Caching: prefix + query-result caching for hot flows; TTLs and explicit invalidation via webhook required.
- Routing: primary region EU (Frankfurt), active passive UK (London) for residency customers; automatic failover to UK only for UK-resident datasets, but NO US failover for those datasets.
- Data handling: encryption at rest with customer KMS, SSO (SAML) integration for admin console, full audit logs (admin actions, model version changes, query sampling).

Operational / commercial notes:
- Interested in Dedicated reserve or Private VPC (on-prem not required). Will evaluate Redwood Optimize for batching recommendations and quantization guidance.
- Procurement: procurement cycle Q2; target contract signing mid-2026.
- Cost sensitivity: heavy — needs a model showing per-query unit economics across traffic tiers + reranker hit rate scenarios.

POC plan & acceptance criteria:
- Week 0: env setup (dedicated EU cluster), SAML test account, KMS integration stub.
- Week 1-2: ingest 200M sample; measure indexing throughput and storage footprint.
- Week 3: run 1000 QPS traffic profile (mixed read/write) and gather latency + cost metrics.
- Acceptance: median search latency <120ms, reranker/ANN combo achieves target precision at top-5, documentation for residency/KMS/audit delivered.

Stakeholders: CTO (Emma Hargreaves), Head of Search (Daniel Osei), Security (Marta Kovacs). AE: Lena Park. SE: Marco Ruiz. CSM: Priya Sinha.
